name: Protected-area transform report
abstract: Report member (`seadotsTransformReport`) that every protected-area transform adds to its output FeatureCollection: which source features were excluded and why, which were routed to another EMODnet layer instead of being duplicated, which are not yet reported to the EEA, which carry an inferred crosswalk value or need a geometric overlay, and where the transformed values differ from the EMODnet record for the same site.
